% Checks cases the fix must not break: with minted's cache off, minted
% highlights each listing in the first LaTeX run, so its ids do not change
% and the index takes no extra LaTeX run. An entry before the listing and
% one after it link to the place of their \index.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[cache=false]{minted}
\usepackage{makeidx}
\makeindex
\begin{document}
\section{Code}
Before the listing\index{rho}.
\begin{minted}[linenos]{python}
total = total + 0
total = total + 1
total = total + 2
total = total + 3
total = total + 4
total = total + 5
total = total + 6
total = total + 7
total = total + 8
total = total + 9
\end{minted}
After the listing\index{pi}.
\printindex
\end{document}
